=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:~552-562 in the PR diff | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The separate-value `--repo upstream` and `--rep upstream` forms do not set `remote_provided` or store the consumed value in `remote_value`, so the guard may check the push against the session checkout instead of requesting confirmation.
  WHY: In `_evaluate_bash`, the `if target.remote and target.remote != "origin":` guard is skipped because `target.remote` is the empty string. The push then falls through to the normal merged-PR check against the session checkout, so `git push --repo upstream` is checked against origin's PR history even though the user explicitly named a different remote. The two new test cases therefore expect the guard to ASK (per the parametrize list name) but the production code never asks, so the new tests will fail.
